text.p: VarTech Systems Inc said Monday it acquired 21st Century Professionals Inc, a privately-held computer company based in Louisiana.
VarTech, a holding company, changed its name from Richmond Capital Corp. It said will keep its ticker symbol of RMCD on the OTC bulletin board.

A spokesman said the company changed its name about a month ago because "VarTech" is a name more easily associated with a computer company. He said VarTech's previous name implied the company had a relationship with the city of Richmond.
The company declined to disclose the dollar value of the deal. A spokesman said the deal involved an exchange of stock.
21st Century Professionals will become a wholly owned subsidiary of VarTech Systems and operate under the name of 21st Century/VarTech.
21st Century Professionals has projected revenues of $8,000,000 for fiscal year 1998.
